landmarks.name: Carthage
landmarks.writeup: Ancient city ruins near Tunis, once a powerful Phoenician city-state and a major center of Mediterranean trade.

landmarks.name: Medina of Tunis
landmarks.writeup: Historic old town of Tunis, known for its narrow alleys, traditional souks, and Islamic architecture.

landmarks.name: Amphitheatre of El Jem
landmarks.writeup: A large Roman amphitheatre, one of the best-preserved in the world, showcasing Tunisia's Roman heritage.

landmarks.name: Bardo National Museum
landmarks.writeup: Museum in Tunis housing one of the world's largest collections of Roman mosaics and artifacts from Tunisia's history.

landmarks.name: Sahara Desert
landmarks.writeup: The southern part of Tunisia extends into the Sahara, offering unique desert landscapes and cultural experiences.

cultural_events.name: Carthage Film Festival
cultural_events.writeup: One of the oldest film festivals in Africa and the Arab world, showcasing African and Arab cinema.

cultural_events.name: International Festival of the Sahara
cultural_events.writeup: Annual festival celebrating desert culture with music, camel races, and traditional crafts in Douz.

cultural_events.name: Festival of the Medina
cultural_events.writeup: Cultural event in Tunis featuring music, dance, and art within the historic Medina.

food_writeup: Tunisian cuisine is a blend of Mediterranean and North African flavors, featuring dishes like couscous, brik (fried pastry), and harissa (spicy chili paste). Seafood, lamb, and fresh vegetables are staples, often seasoned with aromatic spices.
brief_history: Tunisia has a rich history influenced by Phoenician, Roman, Arab, Ottoman, and French cultures. It gained independence from France in 1956 and has since developed as a republic with a diverse cultural heritage.

important_people.name: Habib Bourguiba
important_people.description: First President of Tunisia and leader of independence movement

current_conflicts: Tunisia is generally stable but faces challenges including political tensions, economic issues, and threats from extremist groups in the region.
